summary.text: Pamela Carter is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 4, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Carter is a fourth-generation Arizonan who grew up in the community and holds a master's degree in Communications and Biblical Studies.
The profile says Carter owned and managed a sports medicine and training facility and serves on the board of directors of Help4Kidz, a nonprofit working with at-risk youth and families.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 4 (candidate-submitted statements)
